verdict.rationale: HubSpot's official MCP server explicitly grants MCP-compatible agents read/write access to CRM data including contacts, deals, and engagements, and the REST API supports fetching contacts/custom objects/deals data, which together are the building blocks needed to assemble an account brief (open deals, history) before a meeting. However, there's no explicit documented example of a 'recent emails' retrieval via the MCP/API for a brief workflow, nor any end-to-end demonstration of compiling such a report. Missing for 10: a concrete documented workflow/example showing an agent pulling recent emails plus deals/history into a single pre-meeting brief, and independent/hands-on validation of this exact use case.
